Design:

User Story

As a system user

I want to be able update customer data to its current version

So that I have possibility to correct my mistake or update customer information without affecting existing contracts

 

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Check system user permissions to see edit icon on customer listing/customer detail page, if no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Editing Customer

      1. Allows to edit all customers in system

    2. Editing Customer with the user entered as an Account manager

      1. Allows to edit only the customers to which he/she is an account manager

  2. Page title

    1. The page title on Customer Preview displays customer name and customer number after the word “Customer” (EN) or “ÐÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ” (BG).

    2. EN format: Customer

    3. BG format: ÐÐ»Ð¸ÐµÐ½Ñ

    4. For Legal entities, is Name + Legal form separated by a space.

    5. For Private customers, is Name + Middle name + Surname separated by a space; if Middle name is NULL, omit it (do not leave an extra space).

    6. When UI language is English, use the main Name field values; do not switch to transliterated names.

  3. Clicking on an edit icon in customer listing or in customer detail page will allow edit customer mode

    1. By default system will load currently active customer version (Currently active means to check its validity period and display version which is valid for current date)

    2. Version’s dropdown in bottom right side will allow to display other versions and to update it

  4. Some fields should be disabled as they are not editable:

    1. Customer Type

    2. Customer number

    3. UIC/Personal number

  5. Some checkbox should be editable (Legal Entity) :

    1. Public Procurement Law

    2. Consent to marketing communication

    3. Prefer communication in English

  6. Some checkbox should be editable (Private Customer) :

    1. Business Activity

    2. GDPR

    3. Consent to marketing communication

    4. Prefer communication in English

  7. In customer editing process user should see:

    1. On customer editing view user will see active/inactive values

    2. On each dropdown user will see only active nomenclature values

    3. It will be possible to edit customer with inactive value: 

      1. User will be able to save changes without updating inactive value, only to edit different field and save changes without updating inactive field

      2. If user starts editing of inactive field and opens dropdown, on dropdown will load only active items and to update field only with active value 

  8. It is possible to edit current version, old versions

  9. After system user edits all the fields there is two option to save changes:

    1. Edit current version

      1. All the fields will be updated in current customer version

    2. Create new version

      1. Clicking on this button will create new version of customer with updated data and previous version will not be changed

  10. Clicking on a button 'Update existing version' will update existing customer version

    1. e.g. customer has Version 1 and version 2

    2. customer changes version 1 and saves existing version

    3. Version 1 is updated, version 2 is not changed

  11. Audit Log record should be created on editing process

Update customer's contract when selecting automatic update checkbox in customer new version creation process

User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to select automatic update checkbox in customer new version creation process

So that the contract should be updated

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permissions to select automatic update checkbox in customer while creation new version

    1. If user doesn't have permission, then it is not possible to select the checkbox

  2. When user has permission and the system user tries to create new version of the customer, a modal window should be displayed

  3. Modal window is divided into two separate parts:

    1. The first part contains active contract of the customer and its version

      1. It is possible to select a contract and move it to the second part of the modal window

    2. The second part contains selected contract for which should be submitted

    3. Selecting the checkbox 'Apply new version on active contract' will automatically create a new version of the contract and add the new version of the customer to it

    4. If there are any future version of the contract, the system should apply the new version of the customer to them editing the respective future versions

  4. Clicking on a Save button will check all the validation

    1. If frontend validations are successful, modal window should be closed

    2. If an error happens display with proper field

  5. Clicking on a Cancel or X button will close the modal window

  6. Audit log for contract changes should be created

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2556
